verdict.rationale: Adyen documents genuine batch operations in one area: the Product Feed API ingests up to 200 items per call asynchronously, deletes up to 200 products per call, and reports per-product processing errors. The rest of the evidence shows single-item endpoints, e.g. one-at-a-time payment modifications and refunds via the API and MCP tools. missing for 10: bulk operations for payments, refunds, payouts or account management; bulk actions exposed through the MCP server; independent or hands-on corroboration of batch behavior.
